title: Node selection and/or communication resource allocation in hierarchical tree-like federated learning networks

pse.problem: Inefficient resource allocation in conventional communications networks due to consideration of only directly connected user equipments.
pse.solution_function: The electronic device performs node selection and communication resource allocation in a hierarchical tree federal learning network. It obtains topology information of each communication node, accesses the server node, uploads and downloads data for model learning, and aggregates local patterns from client nodes to update the global learning model.
pse.solution_structure: The electronic device comprises processing circuitry that coordinates with a plurality of communication nodes (client nodes and server nodes), each having local data for model learning. The topology information provides a hierarchical structure for resource allocation.
pse.solution_implementation: The processing circuitry follows the FedAvg algorithm, which includes initial global learning model download, local model learning iterations, uplink and downlink communication for model updates, and aggregation of local patterns by the server node. The number of iterations and sample size are preset parameters.
pse.effect: The solution results in efficient resource allocation across a hierarchical tree federal learning network, as it considers all communication nodes rather than just directly connected ones.
